描述_EN: when wound up, the tricycle moves on two yellow plastic wheels set under the centre and connected to the mechanism. though made in china, the tricyclist's head on this toy has western features. its feet are attached to a bar connected to the mechanism. at the same time the figure's feet go up and down and the bell at the back rings. this toy was probably made for the local chinese market rather than for export.
描述_ZN: 当上弦时，三轮车在两个黄色的塑料轮子上移动，这两个轮子设置在中心下方并与机械装置连接。 虽然是中国制造，但这个玩具上的三轮车夫的头有西方特征。 它的脚被连接到一个与机械装置相连的杆上。 同时，人物的脚会上下移动，后面的铃铛会响。 这个玩具可能是为中国本地市场制作的，而不是为了出口。
